source_record.description:
User Operation Intern

 

Responsibilities

  • Support daily user operations and handle administrative activities efficiently.

  • Assist in maintaining comprehensive user-related records, reports, and operational documentation.

  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure the smooth execution of user operation processes.

  • Monitor and follow up on operational tasks, ensuring timely completion and precise record keeping.

  • Support data collection, analysis, and reporting related to user operations.

  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.

  • Provide general operational and administrative support to the team as needed.

  • Participate in cross-functional projects and actively contribute to achieving business objectives.

 

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program.

  • Available for a full-time internship commitment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Good command of English; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
